summary: NetEase, Inc. filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its Hong Kong Stock Exchange announcement of the date of its board meeting and third-quarter 2026 earnings release. The board will meet November 19, 2026 (Beijing/Hong Kong time) to approve unaudited results for the three months ended September 30, 2026, with results published around 6:00 p.m. and an earnings call at 8:00 p.m. that day. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or structural terms are disclosed; this is an ordinary earnings-calendar notice, not a special situation. Watch the November 19 results and call for operating trends, nothing deal-related.
